policy: These references are scoped anchors selected from the accepted direction. Candidates do not become anchors automatically. Change an anchor only after Nosh selects the new direction; increment the catalog version and record why.

references.scope: Primary environment anchor: pixel treatment, camera, materials, lighting and architectural thickness.
Character rendering and Nosh identity; not an environment camera reference.
Computer highlight crispness only; not the overall shell layout.
Dialogue panel and nameplate treatment only; not inventory layout or clock behavior.

shellLayout.authority: Current implemented shell, interpreted by docs/office/art-direction.md
